title: Multi-file representative sentinel
hypothesis: The verified loop completes the multi-file task without increasing regressions, false completion, cost, or time beyond the declared sentinel limits.

metrics.description: Required criteria accepted by declared evaluators.
Previously passing protected checks that now fail.

decision.adoption_rule: Treat this as a safety sentinel only: both arms must verify with zero regressions and zero false completions, each cell must stay at or below 0.5 credits and 300 seconds, and no efficacy claim may be made from this two-cell sample.
decision.reason: The representative sentinel has not run yet.
